summary: Ships Dashboard Intelligence Phase 4 and a new Object Search feature. The anomaly monitor gains a 'manual' mode (fixed site-wide hourly upper/lower event thresholds, GET/PUT /api/anomaly/settings mode field) alongside the existing per-camera statistical 'smart' baseline, so alerting works from day one with no learning period; two new no-history cards round out the Dashboard: a camera reliability scorecard (GET /api/notifications/reliability, worst-uptime-first, derived from the camera-health monitor's own offline/recovery events) and an alert noise ratio (GET /api/notifications/noise, top cameras by AI-alert volume + unread %) to surface mis-tuned rules. Object Search is a new cross-camera, timeline-linked search UI (its own top-level Intelligence nav item, alongside Teach and the also-promoted Object Classes page) built on the existing object-metadata recorder: date-range + camera + multi-object + min-confidence filters over paged results, each row showing a footage screenshot (new GET /api/recording/segments/{id}/frame endpoint, disk-cached JPEG extraction with the detection box drawn on request) with play + maximize overlay buttons that seek playback to the object's peak-confidence frame, plus CSV/PDF export; the same screenshot-with-play-overlay treatment replaced plain play buttons on the Recordings tab and Notifications event snapshot. Object-metadata capture is now tied directly to the camera's recording-enabled flag (no separate toggle), with the per-camera close window relabeled 'Object sighting cooldown (s)' in the UI. Supporting backend work: a new generic SQL 'In' compare operator (multi-value filtering, implemented across sqlite/postgres/mariadb) backs the Object Search multi-select object filter; a new idx:"group" struct tag lets entities declare non-unique composite secondary indexes reconciled automatically at bootstrap (applied to object_observation and recording_segment camera+time lookups); the vision monitor now honors the Settings -> AI -> Capture 'Interval (ms)' setting as a live per-camera detector-sampling throttle instead of always using the fixed monitor interval; and the AI runtime status check now probes the configured detector command (a user's own Python) before the bundled runtime, so a bring-your-own-Python setup no longer falsely reports 'not installed'.
compatibility: Backward compatible, all additive. Anomaly mode defaults to 'smart' (unchanged behavior) for every existing install; manualUpper/manualLower default to 0 (disabled) until set. The reliability and noise cards read existing notification history with no new schema. The new idx:"group" secondary indexes are created via the standard additive bootstrap reconciliation (CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS) on next startup, no migration needed and safe to run alongside the pre-existing manual index seeder for object_observation. Object-metadata capture behavior is unchanged for cameras that already had metadataEnabled tracking recording; the field is now simply always kept equal to the camera's recording-enabled flag going forward. No new required config.
